messages:
maria: Heads-up — kicking off tenant onboarding for eu12. This will be GPU-heavy (training+inference) so we need project + VNet design, quotas, and a quick validation runbook.
kai: +1. Do we have quota numbers from infra-sales yet? GPU type, expected nodes?
maria: Sales asked for 8x A100 equivalence to start (can be fractional via burst). Plan for room to scale to 32 within 3 months.
devon: For VNet CIDR, recommendation is /20 for tenant pools + separate /24s per subnet. Suggest base: 10.112.0.0/20, with subnets 10.112.0.0/24 (control), 10.112.1.0/24 (gpu-workers), 10.112.2.0/24 (services).
irene: We should avoid using 10.112.0.0 if already reserved in global mapping. Can we use 10.200.0.0/20 instead?
maria: good catch — ok 10.200.0.0/20.
network-eng: For NAT and egress, prefer dedicated NAT gateway in a shared-services subnet. We'll also enable flow logs on the tenant subnets for cost accounting.
kai: Owners: I can take cloud-account setup (IAM, billing tags), devon can own VNet + subnets, network-eng takes routing/peering and NAT, irene does quota request with cloud provider.
maria: Action items: 1) Create project with billing tags (team:redwood-ml tenant:eu12). 2) Apply VNet module. 3) Request GPU quota and service limits. 4) Validate network connectivity and NAT. 5) Smoke run spawn and node health check.
oncall-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-4821 "eu12 tenant onboarding - project + VNet" (link: https://tickets.redwood.internal/INFRA-4821)
devon: Terraform snippet I'll use (quick copy):
```
module "tenant_vnet" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo.redwood.dev/infra/modules/vnet.git//tenant"
  name = "eu12-tenant-vnet"
  cidr = "10.200.0.0/20"
  subnets = {
    control = "10.200.0.0/24"
    workers = "10.200.1.0/24"
    services = "10.200.2.0/24"
  }
  tags = {team = "redwood-ml" tenant = "eu12"}
}
```
kai: Quick validation checklist for later:
- project exists + billing tag
- IAM roles: infra-runner, gpu-ops, network-admin created
- VNet and three subnets provisioned
- NAT gateway present and route table attached
- Private DNS zone for internal registry
- Flow logs enabled
- GPU quota granted and nodes boot successfully
maria: Cost note: set billing alerts for monthly estimate >= $X (placeholder until devon posts expected node hours). Also tag all resources with cost-center and owner.
irene: I'll open the quota request; expected initial target: 8 A100s, request soft + hard to 32 to avoid repeated requests.
network-eng: For peering: we'll peer tenant VNet to shared-services VNet (10.0.0.0/16) and enable route propagation. Use hub-and-spoke. Also set up subnet-level NSGs to allow MSK, registry, and metrics ports.
devon: After infra ready I'll run small smoke: spin 2 GPU instances, run nginx + gpu validator container. I'll post logs here. Anyone want access to the terraform plan output before apply?
kai: Please post plan. I'll review IAM bits.
maria: Timeline: aim to have account + VNet by EOD tomorrow, quota in <72h assuming provider approvals. We'll do smoke the day after quota granted.
maría: (typo) — ignore
maria: tagging this thread INFRA-4821 and linking to onboarding doc: https://docs.redwood.dev/onboarding/tenant-networking
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: run smoke-check at 2025-06-20T09:00:00Z (cron)
devon: Plan posted: https://ci.redwood.dev/plan/1752500000
kai: LGTM on plan, especially the IAM least-privilege mappings. I'll approve when terraform plan passes.
maria: Thanks all — will sync status in morning standup. :thumbsup:
